{"subject":"Checking in from Harbor Street","body":"Hi,

I've been thinking about Orum and wanted to check in to see how things are going. I'd love to hear what the team has been focused on lately and what's ahead for you.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to set up a 20-minute call in the next few weeks. Just reply with a couple of times that work, and I'll make it happen.

Hope all is well.

Maya"}
